Dashboard.headline: Choose a demo workspace.
Dashboard.intro: Use a demo workspace, or complete signup and onboarding to enter as a brand or creator.
Dashboard.cardBody: {userName} signs in as {role} for a {workspaceType} workspace.

login.title: Sign in to your workspace.
login.body: Use your email and password to return to a brand, creator, agency, or admin workspace.

register.title: Start with email and password.
register.body: New users choose a brand or creator role before entering the app.

forgotPassword.title: Request a password reset.
forgotPassword.body: Enter your account email to create a reset-token request.
forgotPassword.sent: If the address is valid, a reset request has been accepted.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password.
resetPassword.body: Use a reset token and a new password with at least eight characters.

logout.title: End this session.
logout.body: Signing out clears the prototype session cookies for this browser.

role.title: Choose how you will use Paano.
role.body: A new user must choose brand or creator before entering the protected app.
role.brandBody: Run campaigns, manage spaces, shortlist creators, and track manual collaborations.
role.creatorBody: Build a creator card, receive collaboration requests, and manage earnings placeholders.

brand.title: Set up your brand workspace.
brand.body: Tell us who the company is and the audience you want LinkedIn creators to reach.

creator.title: Set up your creator profile.
creator.body: Capture the baseline LinkedIn profile details needed for a manual marketplace card.
creator.headline: Headline

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.description: Review account and workspace activity from one protected center.
Notifications.emptyBody: New onboarding and workspace events will appear here once persisted workflows are connected.

guard.title: This workspace area is protected.
guard.body: The route resolved to {state}. Use the dashboard selector to enter as a demo brand, creator, agency, or admin user.

Brand.title: Brand overview
Brand.description: Manage spaces, campaigns, creators, manual collaborations, messages, billing placeholders, and workspace settings from a single protected shell.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.body: Create and track campaigns under a space.

marketplace.title: Creator marketplace
marketplace.body: Browse verified creators by topic, audience, country, and fixed post rate.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.body: Create the first workspace-owned space with name, website, description, industry, ICP, locations, and default CTA URL.
spaces.action: Next action: add create/edit forms in Version 1 Sprint 2.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.body: Campaigns belong to a space and reserve draft, active, completed, and cancelled states for the manual marketplace workflow.

marketplace.title: Creator marketplace
marketplace.body: Marketplace reads will expose verified creator profiles without leaking creator workspace settings or admin review notes.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Wallet and invoice panels are placeholders backed by append-only wallet ledger records.

BrandSpaces.title: Spaces
BrandSpaces.description: Organize campaigns around a product, audience, or destination.

BrandCampaigns.title: Campaigns
BrandCampaigns.description: Plan campaigns under a specific space with clear status and budget ownership.

Creator.title: Creator overview
Creator.description: Review profile completion, collaboration requests, draft notes, published post submission, earnings placeholders, affiliate link, messages, and settings.

card.title: My Card
card.body: Creator profile fields are isolated behind the creator workspace and can later be published through an explicit public card status.

collaborations.title: Collaboration requests
collaborations.body: Creators can only see collaborations where their creator profile is attached; brand customer data remains hidden unless a later sprint explicitly shares it.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.body: Manual earning states are modeled separately from wallet ledger entries so payout automation can arrive later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Payment details and delete account are represented as protected settings surfaces, with destructive actions deferred until full auth is implemented.

Marketplace.title: Creator marketplace
Marketplace.description: Find verified LinkedIn creators by topic, location, audience, and fixed post rate.
Marketplace.notFoundBody: This creator is unavailable or has not published a card.

CreatorCard.title: My Card
CreatorCard.description: Edit your creator profile and preview the public-facing card.
CreatorCard.previewBody: Only published card fields are visible to brands and public visitors.
CreatorCard.editDescription: Keep your marketplace details accurate and ready for review.
CreatorCard.headline: Headline

Agency.title: Agency workspace
Agency.description: Agency routes are reserved in the app shell now, while the client workspace and creator roster workflows remain intentionally out of scope until Version 4.

empty.title: Agency features are reserved
empty.body: The data model and navigation can recognize agency workspace types, but Sprint 1 does not expose cross-client data, roster imports, or agency reporting.
empty.action: Future version: Version 4 introduces agency workflow records.

Admin.title: Admin overview
Admin.description: Ops users can review creator, brand, campaign, collaboration, and support queues with auditable state changes.

reviewEmpty.title: Review queue
reviewEmpty.body: Admin review items track subject type, subject ID, review status, assignee, notes, timestamps, and optional workspace ownership.
reviewEmpty.action: Open /admin/review with an admin demo identity.

sensitiveEmpty.title: Sensitive updates
sensitiveEmpty.body: State changes must validate transitions server-side and produce audit log records once mutation routes update protected records.

AdminReview.title: Review queue
AdminReview.description: Reviewable records use new, in_review, approved, rejected, needs_changes, and archived states.

empty.title: Empty queue state
empty.body: When no records need review, this route should show a clear empty state instead of an empty table.

AdminSupport.title: Support queue
AdminSupport.description: Support is reserved as an admin shell route so future campaign disputes and cancellation workflows have a protected destination.

empty.title: No support items
empty.body: Support records are not introduced in Sprint 1. This shell confirms routing, navigation, and permission behavior for the future module.

footer.blurb: The B2B LinkedIn creator marketplace for focused campaigns and credible distribution.

home.headline: Turn trusted voices into your next growth channel.
home.intro: Paano helps B2B teams discover vetted LinkedIn creators, brief campaigns, and manage collaborations in one focused workspace.

home.proofOne: Find creators by audience, topic, and fit.
